name: baby-tracker
description: Baby Tracker — twin-first daily journal and family health record for babies.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @baby-tracker/shared && run-p dev:shared dev:api dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @baby-tracker/shared && run-s build:api build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @baby-tracker/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @baby-tracker/shared && vitest run --project shared --project api-unit --project web-unit --project web-dom
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace @baby-tracker/shared && vitest run --project api-integration
